This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Solo" />

==Biology and appearance==
The diminutive [[humanoid]] species was distinguished by their [[Color|blue]]<ref name="Solo" /> or tan and pink skin,<ref name="Andor" /> as well as their short stature, large [[Bone|craniums]], pointed [[ear]]s, elongated [[Mouth|snouts]], large yellow [[eye]]s with small black pupils, and singular long patch of blonde [[hair]] that grew from the backs of their heads.<ref name="Solo" />

==Species in the galaxy==
[[File:BlutopianUnidentifiedSpecies-DaughterOfFerrix.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A member of this species sleeps with a Blutopian]]
During [[10 BBY]]<ref name="Timeline">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref>, multiple members of this species served as waitstaff aboard [[Dryden Vos]]'s [[Nau'ur-class yacht|''Nau'ur''-class yacht]], ''[[First Light]]''.<ref name="Solo" /> Later, in [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{AndorDate|111}}</ref> a member of this species shared a bed with a [[Blutopian]] in a room on the [[planet]] [[Niamos]], still asleep when [[Cassian Jeron Andor]] snuck past them to retrieve items he had stowed away in their bathroom during a prior stay.<ref name="Andor" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species made their debut in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'', directed by [[Ron Howard]].<ref name="Solo" /> They were designed by concept artist [[Jake Lunt Davies]], before their design was further fleshed out by fellow artist [[Adam Brockbank]].<ref name="Artbook">''[[The Art of Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> Keeper of the [[Holocron continuity database|Holocron]] [[Leland Chee]] stated that the two instances of this species created for the film were assigned the production numbers M017 and M018, while the alternately colored one created for the [[Daughter of Ferrix|eleventh episode]] of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the television series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']] was referred to as L085. Additionally, Chee also revealed that the species was given a name that was intended to be somehow via the [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]] [[Star Wars: Hyperspace Lounge|Cruise Lines]], though said name was either never actually made public or simply has not been uncovered as of yet.<ref name="Production">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-11-08|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1436649141332873226|quote=In the Holocron, I am treating them as the same species. In Solo they had the production numbers M017/M018. In Andor they were L085. We created a species name for Disney Cruise Lines but I don't know if it was ever used.|archivefile=File:LelandChee-UnidentifiedSpeciesFirstLight-Discord.png}} {{C|In response to: "Hey @HolocronKeeper, hope all is well! Back with my newest species-related question that I was hoping you might have some insight on? The alien sleeping beside this [[Blutopian]] in Andor's "Daughter of Ferrix" episode has long been a point of contention as it's mostly just indiscernible fleshy elements, however, it was recently pointed out to me that it may actually be a member of this species seen on the First Light in "Solo: A Star Wars Story." It definitely appears that some of the features line up, though given the differences in coloration, with this one being pinkish and the Solo individuals appearing to be blue, I'm wary of confirming anything without additional input. Do you know if a new version of the alien made for Andor, if that's indeed what's in the scene at all, and if not, is this a known species at all?"}}</ref>
